channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 6 Oct: Harare heavy drizzle · high 24° / low 15°
item.description: Harare: high 24°, low 15° (heavy drizzle) · Bulawayo: high 26°, low 14° (drizzle) · Mutare: high 28°, low 16° (thunderstorm) · Gweru: high 26°, low 14° (showers) · Masvingo: high 28°, low 16° (drizzle) · Victoria Falls: high 32°, low 18° (light drizzle) Tsumo yezuva: Kakara kununa hudya kamwe.
